title: fix(runtime): an un-walled boot seed's person references resolve to the first admin once that admin exists
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi96QpUuH77yeiDEFd5Vi6Pg1)_

Fixes #34458
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:单租户(未开组织隔离墙)首次启动时,种子数据里指向首个管理员的人员字段(负责人、审核人等)在管理员账号创建后会被自动补上,不再永久留空。
- 为什么改:种子先于首个管理员落库,人员引用解析不到就写成空;此前只有 owner_id 会被交接,示例记录的负责人、审核人一直显示为"未分配",后续启动也不会修复。
- 风险与回滚:只回填种子自己写入、且该列仍为空的行;访客写的行和期间被人手动改过的值都不动。回滚即 revert 本 PR,已回填的值保留,不影响其它数据。
- 先看:packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts 的 registerSeedPersonReferenceHandoff(sys_user 插入后触发);packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts 的 resolveHeldPersonReferences(按行 id 加列为空条件写入);packages/plugins/organizations/src/default-organization-seed-owner.wall.test.ts。
- 两分钟验证:pnpm --filter @objectstack/organizations exec vitest run src/default-organization-seed-owner.wall.test.ts,预期 5 个用例全绿,未开墙用例里 assignee、reviewer、owner_id 都等于管理员 id。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

On an un-walled (single-tenant) first boot the inline boot seed loads before the first admin's `sys_user` row exists, so a `Field.user()` / `Field.lookup('sys_user')` value naming that admin landed NULL. The first-admin handoff (`claimSeedOwnership`) writes `owner_id` only, and a later boot's replay of a create-only dataset leaves an existing row as it is, so `assignee` / `reviewer` style columns stayed NULL for good.

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts`: pass 2 now holds each person reference it left NULL (target `sys_user`, row id known) as a `HeldPersonReference`. New `SeedLoaderService#resolveHeldPersonReferences()` retries them with the loader's own `resolveReferenceItem` (same organization), and writes a resolved value with a compare-and-set update by row id and `FIELD = null`. So a row the seed did not write is never reached (ADR-0138 D1), and a value set since is kept. Retries are serialized. A reference that still misses stays held. `heldPersonReferenceCount()` reports how many are held. The held list resets per `load`.
- `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts`: after the inline boot seed, `AppPlugin` keeps the loader while it holds references. A new ObjectQL middleware (`registerSeedPersonReferenceHandoff`) runs the retry after every `sys_user` create/insert and releases the loader once it holds none. Failure is best-effort and logged at `warn`, like the tenancy handoff beside it. The user insert always stands.
- The walled boot is unchanged: it writes no inline seed, and its per-organization replay already waits for the owner's membership (#34457).
- No change under `packages/spec/src/**`; no contract change. The new loader methods are on the concrete `SeedLoaderService` class and are not part of `ISeedLoaderService`.
- Changeset `.changeset/34458-unwalled-seed-person-refs.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/runtime`.

## Tests

`packages/plugins/organizations/src/default-organization-seed-owner.wall.test.ts`. This is the forced test change the card names:

- The CONTROL describe is flipped as the card's Done-when requires. It was titled `control: the same seed on an un-walled boot reads as it did before the fix` and asserted `assignee: null, reviewer: null, owner_id: adminId`. It is now titled `the same seed on an un-walled boot resolves the first admin once that admin exists` and asserts `assignee`, `reviewer` and `owner_id` all equal the admin id.
- New describe `un-walled: a held seed person reference fills only the seed's own rows, and only while still NULL`. Its PREMISE leg shows the reference is NULL before the named person signs up, and that the admin's insert did not fill it. Its main leg covers three rows. The seed's row resolves to the late person once they exist. A seeded row assigned by hand in the meantime keeps that assignment. A guest-written row with a NULL person stays NULL (the ADR-0138 D1 negative leg).

Ablation (one-shot, not kept). The handoff's loader read in `app-plugin.ts` was replaced with an always-undefined read through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The marker was proved in `packages/runtime/dist` with `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` (exit 0) after a rebuild. The organizations suite then went red on exactly the two new/flipped legs: `Tests 2 failed | 3 passed (5)`. Restore leg: blob hash equal to HEAD, rebuild, preflight `--absent` exit 0, then `Tests 5 passed (5)`.

## Acceptance notes

- The held references live in process memory. If the process restarts between the boot seed and the first admin's sign-up, the references are not retried. This PR covers the case the card names and the tests drive, where the first admin's `sys_user` row is inserted by the same process that ran the boot seed. A restart before sign-up was not measured. A durable retry would need the seed-settlement contract to carry the held references, which is a spec change this card does not take. Filed: #34542.
- The retry runs after every `sys_user` insert only while the loader still holds references; once none are held, the middleware returns at its first check.
- The pass-2 `UNRESOLVED` error text still says "No further seed pass retries this". That remains literally true, since the held retry is not a seed pass, and its SCOPE clause already says a later boot step can still write the column. Dropped: the sentence is still literally true, because the held retry is a write after the seed, not a seed pass.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts` overlaps open PR #34429: `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD refs/pull/34429/head` at 2a00228cf exits 0 (tree 0e6916848), with no conflict.

## Verification

Gate sweep: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 72 families for this diff. Each was run with stdin closed and its exit code captured before any pipe. Reconciliation with `--ran` reports `72 derived, 72 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. Two families first answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET) and were re-run once the prerequisite was met. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its pinned fixture commit fetched, then exited 0 with 48 cases. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needed every package built, then exited 0 with 124 entry points across 72 packages.

The last 5 families and the two re-runs ran on 0916d339e, which is e2ab3fd22 plus a merge of origin/main 6c7d730f1. That merge touches none of the 4 files of this diff, and the re-derivation on 0916d339e lists the same 72 commands.
